changelog:
v2.3.0 — Playback Stability Hardening

• Movies now retry up to 6 times before showing error (was 3)
• Series episodes retry up to 5 times, live channels stay at 3
• Retry delays extended: 1s, 3s, 5s, 8s, 12s, 15s
• NEW: Stall detector — if buffering hangs silently (no error), automatically forces a reconnect
• VOD/Series stall timeout: 30 seconds, Live: 15 seconds
• Fixes reports of movies stopping mid-playback
